experiences.description: NordAxon has developed Emely, an AI-powered MLaaS language learning assistant designed to enhance language skills in Swedish. As key contributors to the project, my colleague and I were primarily responsible for conducting comprehensive evaluations of Emely's overall user experience and usability. These evaluations involved engaging with real users to gather valuable insights and feedback to further enhance Emely's performance and user satisfaction.
